pages.title: Rituals
pages.text: Rituals allow to summon spirits into our plane of existence, or bind them into objects or living beings. Every ritual consists of a $(#ad03fc)Pentacle$(), $(#ad03fc)Ritual Ingredients$() provided via sacrificial bowls, a $(#ad03fc)Starting Item$() and optionally the $(#ad03fc)Sacrifice$() of living $()
